title: Predicting copper leaching from slag: an interpretable machine learning approach under oxidative sulfuric acid conditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19320-19333
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01571A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sung-Jin Kim, Song-Sae Kang, Kyong-Nam Pae, Song-Il Pak, Hyon-Il Jo, Ryong-Jin Kim
An interpretable XGBoost model predicts copper leaching efficiency from slag with R2 = 0.9794. SHAP analysis shows time, acid, and temperature dominate, enabling quantitative process optimization for sustainable recovery.
